dct_title_s: Plat map showing enumeration districts as of April 1st, 1920
dct_alternative_sm: Plat map showing enumeration districts as of April 1st, 1920
dct_description_sm: Title and statement of responsibility from paste-on label.; Boundaries and numbers for enumeration are hand-marked in ink on a copy of Hudson's indexed map of Minneapolis, 1929 ed.; Enumeration districts are checked off in red colored pencil. Some districts are labeled with letters of the alphabet in green pencil.; "Total population - 380,582 October 1931."; "1400 / 310." -- Marked in pencil on map recto and verso.; Base map: "Copyright 1929, Hudson Map Company."
